title: The First Order Gets a Clean Room: bind the judge before Scion learns

local: npx playwright test tests/coursemapper.spec.js tests/local-ai-runtime.spec.js tests/export-smoke.spec.js

ciFast.note: The implementation commit must pass Fast verification before merge.

ciDeep.note: This release changes deterministic clean-room construction, validation, and sealing contracts. It performs no model call, judgment, adapter training, device capture, or provider request.

deploy.note: Production proof will be sealed after the exact merged commit deploys and passes a cache-bypassed probe.

liveProvider.note: No model provider is used. The tracked workbook is reconstructed from the frozen blank anonymous handoff and contains no completed judgment.

manualHuman.note: Codex remains the declared sole judge. This release makes no human, instructor, classroom, independent-review, or multi-judge claim and does not yet perform a Codex judgment.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: All 34 canonical gold courses, 4,479 unit tests, and 107 real-Chromium tests passed locally. These gates establish software and compiler regression safety only; they do not turn a blank workbook into model-quality evidence.

claims.summary: The chunked clean-room workbook validates and seals either A/B or B/A while retaining exact reconstruction of the historical B/A artifact.
A tracked A/B-only workbook binds 128 source-backed anonymous cases into eight immutable chunks without a reverse-order payload, organizer mapping, model mapping, or outcome.
First-order construction refuses a missing Codex identity and completion refuses model, revision, runtime, or prompt drift from the predeclared campaign identity.
Completed chunks must share one fresh matching judge session and are assembled only in memory before atomic encrypted-envelope and 0600-key output.
The release records campaign readiness with zero completed judgments, zero approved preferences, zero training rows, and no adapter or model-quality claim.
